user_saw: ClawRouter-routed vision models could show as text-only and use router pricing limits instead of the selected endpoint's context and output limits.
summary: ClawRouter catalog discovery now reads the selected endpoint's clawrouter.native-capabilities.v1 facts for text/image input, context window, context tokens and output cap, and tolerates audio/video/json modalities instead of falling back to text-only.
reasoning: The catalog parser from aab56517 (#178859) deliberately failed unknown modalities closed to ["text"] and took limits from pricing rows, which was correct for the catalog shape it was written against; the router service later supplied per-endpoint native capability facts and wider modality lists, which the plugin did not consume. That is an external contract change exposing older code, not a broken in-repo commit; the PR is framed as campaign work adopting an existing router contract, so this borders on not-a-defect and no single cause commit applies.
